name: AL Language Coverage Tests (OnPrem)
brief: Executable proof for the AL surface that only a Target = OnPrem app can name at all.
description: A second, small test app whose only reason to exist is its target. Microsoft declares a number of system tables Scope = OnPrem, and an AL object in a Target = Cloud app cannot name them: the compiler rejects it with AL0296, and the RecordRef escape hatch is refused at runtime as well. The main coverage app stays Target = Cloud and keeps its meaning; this one carries the tests that are impossible to express there. Keep it small - a test belongs here only when it cannot compile in the Cloud app.
